raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What
In `dsv4pro/1k1k/2p1d-ep16-mtp.yaml`, raise `prefill_mem_fraction_static` from 0.85 to 0.88. MORI EP v2 stays on.

#40666 made MORI EP v2 the default. It reserves 4 GiB per GPU for its symmetric arena, which together with the MTP draft model leaves the prefill KV budget at 1.86 GB. The fixed KV state alone needs about 5 GB, so the prefill servers stop at start-up with `Not enough memory. Please try to increase --mem-fraction-static`. This test failed in the 2026-10-12 nightly and passed before #40666.

Each 0.01 of the fraction adds about 2.9 GB per GPU. At 0.88 the budget is 10.17 GB.

## Validation
On pit2 (4 nodes), main `6a7abcf`, same image as the nightly. EP v2 active in every run.
- 0.85 (unchanged): fails, KV budget 1.86 GB.
- 0.87: passes, budget 7.40 GB, GSM8K 0.951.
- 0.88: passes, budget 10.17 GB, GSM8K 0.947 (gate 0.91), 7 of 7 result files, no out-of-memory in prefill.

0.87 clears the roughly 7.2 GB needed by only 0.2 GB, so 0.88 is proposed.

nodes.body:
Verification run: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38354542913
The run combines #43944, #43945, #43977 and #43985 on top of current main.

Status: **passed**.

| Leg | Result | GSM8K (gate 0.91) | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dsv4pro-fp8-1k1k-2p1d-ep16-mtp` | pass | 0.951 | 35 min |

Prefill started with no "Not enough memory" error, and all 7 concurrencies wrote results.

LGTM on the change. The 0.85 failure lines up with the 2026-10-12 nightly, and the plain fp8 EP16 leg still passing at 0.85 is consistent with the MTP draft being what tips it over.

Two things before merge:

1. `scripts/ci/slurm/recipes/mi355x-fp8/dsv4pro/1k1k/2p1d-ep16.yaml` explains its 0.85 with "...and the FP8 MTP recipe already runs at 0.85." That goes stale with this PR, so please update it here.
2. The plain recipe documents why it uses 0.85; this one would now have an unexplained 0.88. A two-line comment would help: the MORI EP v2 arena (4 GiB/GPU) plus the MTP draft leave about 1.9 GB of KV at 0.85.

Minor, in the description: it says the fixed KV state "needs about 5 GB" and later "the roughly 7.2 GB needed". Worth stating one number, or what the extra ~2.2 GB is.
